name: HairGraftPro – Hair Transplant & SMP Clinic Toolkit
author: aggarwalrahul87

sections.description:
HairGraftPro lets any hair transplant or SMP (Scalp Micropigmentation) clinic add conversion-focused, Elementor-native tools to their website — a visitor gets an instant graft/cost estimate, and the clinic gets the lead automatically, with no manual follow-up needed to capture it.

Every core feature below works on a plain WordPress + Elementor (free) install. No external account, API key, or paid service is required to use any part of this free plugin.

Set up your calculator and pricing in wp-admin

  • A dedicated HairGraftPro settings screen for configuring per-procedure pricing (FUE, DHI, SMP), clinical badges, disclaimers, and email notifications — no code editing required.
  • Fully editable email templates, with placeholders for the visitor’s details and estimate, for both the clinic notification and the optional patient auto-reply.
  • A global or per-calculator medical disclaimer with a required consent checkbox, since every estimate is informational, not a diagnosis.

What visitors see on your site

  • Graft & Cost Calculator — a step-by-step Norwood/Ludwig visual selector that walks a visitor to an estimated graft count and price range, then captures their consultation request.
  • Before/After Comparison Slider — an interactive split-screen slider for real patient results, with optional clinical badges (grafts, technique, stage, timeline, surgeon, hair type, donor density).

Publish results with Case Studies

  • A dedicated Case Studies post type, separate from your regular blog, for publishing patient outcomes with structured metadata (before/after photos, grafts, timeline, age, surgeon) rather than freeform posts.

Upgrade to HairGraftPro Pro

A separate Pro version, sold independently from aggarwalrahul.com, adds an AI photo-based hair loss scanner, PRP / GFC / SMP session calculators, a combined multi-treatment quote builder, and more. This free plugin works fully on its own and never requires the Pro version — upgrade prompts inside the plugin link out to the Pro product page and nothing is ever unlocked without a separate purchase there.

This plugin requires Elementor (free) to be installed and active.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the hairgraftpro folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it directly from your WordPress admin under Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Make sure the free Elementor plugin is installed and active.
  4. Go to HairGraftPro in your WordPress admin menu to configure pricing, badges, disclaimers and email notifications.
  5. Edit any page with Elementor, open the Elements panel, and find the HairGraftPro – Hair & SMP Suite category to drag in the Graft Calculator or Before/After Slider widgets.
sections.faq:
Do I need Elementor Pro?

No. HairGraftPro’s widgets work with the free version of Elementor. You only need Elementor (free) installed and active.

Is the graft/cost estimate medical advice?

No. The calculator provides an estimate for informational purposes only, and is not a medical diagnosis or treatment recommendation. A configurable disclaimer with a required consent checkbox is shown to visitors before they submit a consultation request.

Where do consultation requests go?

To the admin email address(es) you configure under HairGraftPro → Email Notifications. You can customize the subject and body of both the clinic notification email and the optional patient auto-reply.

Does this plugin phone home or track my site?

No. This free version makes no external network requests and includes no analytics, licensing or tracking code of any kind.

What does the Pro version add?

An AI-based photo hair-loss scanner, PRP/GFC/SMP session calculators, a combined treatment quote builder, and additional features, sold separately from the plugin author’s website. This free plugin is fully functional without it.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Fixed: the Before/After widget collapsed into a thin strip when placed in an Elementor Flexbox container with Width set to Default. It now fills the container by default; a Custom Width you set is still respected.
  • Fixed: before and after photos were cropped to fit a widescreen frame. The frame now matches the shape of the uploaded photo by default, so the whole photo is always shown. Very tall photos are kept within the screen height.
  • Added: a 5:4 frame shape, a “Photo Fit” setting (show the whole photo, or fill the frame), and a “Frame Background” colour.
  • Added: recommended photo size (1250 x 1000 px, 5:4) shown in the widget and the Case Study editor.
  • Fixed: the Follicle HD Zoom lens now magnifies exactly the point under the cursor.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release on WordPress.org: Graft & Cost Calculator, Before/After Slider, Case Studies post type, consultation lead capture with email notifications, and medical disclaimer controls.
